Known science foundations of Extreme Energy-to-Matter Research Platform.

Pair production is textbook; colliders create particles routinely. But producing useful materials from energy is absurdly inefficient (E=mc^2 works against you). The platform studies limits honestly.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.
